eyebrow: Soles4Souls · Giving ShoesDay 2026 · Pinned post #1 · posts mid-November
title: GSD Announcement:
headline: Pinned post #1: a paper reveal gives the date, Giving ShoesDay is December 1st, then the kids, the goal and the ask.
story: A paper says “Get excited...”. A foot steps on another paper; when it lifts, the date is there: Giving ShoesDay is December 1st. The music lifts on the foot lift.
Then B-roll beats that build: kids open shoe boxes, try on new shoes, run and play, while Sydney's cards say what a new pair can do and what the goal is: 2,500 kids by midnight on December 1st.

Loops: L1 “Excited for what?” opens at 0:00 and closes at about 0:03 on the date. L2 “Can they reach 2,500 kids in one day?” opens on the goal card and closes in the button. Button: “We can't do it without you.” over the happiest reaction you have, then Sydney's holiday end slide.
do: Open on the paper “Get Excited!” with the card already on screen.
Make the foot lift reveal the date on a beat, then hold the date for about 1 s.
Kids, shoes and smiles under every mission card (the shots are named per row).
Warm, hopeful, light-bells music that builds on the reveal.
dont: No Christmas imagery: no Santa, no trees, no “Merry Christmas”. Holiday vibes only.
No logo at 0:00 and no logo added to the end slide: the wordmark is already on it.
No stock footage. Client footage only.
No voice-over, no lower thirds, no second aspect ratio.
Don't make it about Soles4Souls history or a general brand message.

files: Nick's editor brief on this Monday item (29 Oct). This page is that plan.
S4S - Giving ShoesDay + End of Year 2026 - client editing doc (Sydney, 19 Oct). On-screen words are Sydney's.
Intro paper clip · Happy kids B-roll (vertical IMG_ clips; the C00xx clips are vertical shots stored sideways, rotate them 90°) · Christe's 4EveryKid upload
Warm, hopeful, light holiday bells, instrumental, licensed. Pick a track family you can reuse: Pie 1 and Pie 2 (also yours) must sound like the same campaign.

Sydney's holiday end slide: Holiday_bkg_social_V1_2.jpg (light blue) or Holiday_bkg_social_V2_2.jpg (dark blue). 9:16, the Soles4Souls wordmark is already in the top of the slide. CTA text in the open middle; no extra logo.

S4S graphics package (Drive): lower third bar, title plate, underline, circle burst, focus brackets, color wipe, shape swipe, topic tag, texture and gradient loops, 1080×1920, 30 fps, ProRes 4444. The plates are empty: type the words on them. The Motion graphics tab on this page has the graphics this script asks for as transparent .mov files.

Giving ShoesDay is Tuesday, December 1st. Goal: 2,500 kids with new shoes. End of Year runs December 2 to 31; goal 5,000 kids. Spelling: Soles4Souls, Giving ShoesDay (capital S and D), 4EveryKid, s4s.org/gsd.

Ready-made in the Motion graphics tab: Sydney's holiday slide with this video's call to action already on it. Plain slides: V1 light blue · V2 dark blue. The S4S logo is already on the slide; no extra logo.
tech: iPhone HEVC, 1080×1920 vertical, 30 fps (intro clip and IMG_ kids clips). The C00xx clips in the kids folder are 4K shot vertical but stored sideways: rotate 90° before you crop.
Horizontal clips: crop to 9:16 with faces inside the frame. Never stretch.

Cards big and centered, out of the bottom 20% and away from the right edge (Instagram buttons sit there). Hold each card long enough to read twice: text size is Soles4Souls' most common note. Titles in Buenos Aires (Roboto Black if you don't have it), body Roboto. Black text on teal, never white on teal. The first card is on screen at 0:00 and does not animate on; later cards can.
H.264 MP4, 1080×1920, 9:16 only. Upload to Frame.io with the Edit Key in the file name.
None: there are no spoken lines. The cards are the text.
checklist: First card on screen at frame 1. No logo at 0:00.
Every card matches Sydney's words exactly: Soles4Souls, Giving ShoesDay, s4s.org/gsd.
Text readable on a phone. Nothing in the bottom 20% or under the right-side buttons.
The music lifts on the foot lift. The date frame is the cover frame.
No Christmas imagery. Client footage only.
End = Sydney's holiday slide + the exact CTA from this plan. No extra logo: the wordmark is already on the slide.
Music licensed, levels even, no clipping.
1080×1920, 24 fps timeline, Edit Key in the file name.

decisions.b: Sydney's cards at 00:11 and 00:17 carry donation amounts. They stay word for word in this plan because they are her on-screen copy, but the Motion graphics tab does not build money lines: the editor types them on the S4S title plate. Nick: confirm they stay as written.

client_note: Why this matters: Giving ShoesDay (1 Dec) is Soles4Souls' biggest day of the year. Sydney wrote every line herself: keep it joy themed and positive.
